name: Landing Roll
benefit:
If you are tripped, you can spend an immediate action to move 5 feet without provoking an attack of opportunity. This does not count as taking a 5-foot step. You fall prone after this movement. 
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 125
When using this feat, you can spend 5 stamina points to stand up as part of your immediate action after you move. Standing up provokes attacks of opportunity.
flavor: You have learned the technique of rolling safely away when an enemy trips you.
